subject: marketing
objective: Which campaign paid for itself after the cost of the sale?
instruction: A business is preparing a marketing & customers analysis. The question is: Which campaign paid for itself after the cost of the sale. The tile covers Enter impressions, clicks, conversions, spend and revenue and read the click-through, cost per click and per thousand impressions, cost per acquisition, return on ad spend and the break-even return. The declared figures are: impressions 250000; clicks 6000; conversions 220; spend 60000; revenue 150000; contribution margin rate 0.45. Use campaign efficiency in a competitive market and industry context, and report the method's result.
